name: Jaxon Flowers
strengths: Flowers takes the designed QB run, jump-cuts the linebacker, and outruns the secondary for the long score.
Flowers rolls right and drives the deep ball 45 yards in the air, hitting the receiver in stride.
Flowers pulls the read, bounces outside, and wins the edge with a long stride.
Flowers extends the play when the pocket breaks and still gets the ball out with a snappy release.
weaknesses: Flowers throws back across his body on the move and the base in the pocket is still upper-body arm talent more than a firm step.
comparison: Flowers comps to Justin Fields — 6-3 / 227 dual-threat QB with a long stride, off-platform arm, and the same athletic tools that also play in the secondary.
projection: Flowers projects as a Year 1 developmental dual-threat / ATH, then he competes for the job in Year 2, with Year 3 starter upside if the pocket base catches the arm.
schemeFit: Flowers fits a dual-threat quarterback who can also move as an athlete — the board lists safety, but the tape we have is quarterback.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-09-23 from Bolles sophomore reel titled Dual Threat QB (embed 22173193 / 6940a3df540685f13c786fa3). Visitor list still bills him S; tape on this sit is QB. Comp height-matched at 6-3 — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Jaxon Flowers is a 2028 ATH · listed 6-3 / 185 · The Bolles School (Jacksonville, FL) · expected Ole Miss weekend in the Swamp.
angle: Lead with the 75-yard QB run and the rollout deep ball; Flowers is a dual-threat on this reel.
insiderNotes: Flowers is a 6-3 / 185 athlete who played quarterback — designed runs for scores, a 45-yard rollout strike, and a snappy release when the pocket breaks. Florida has also looked at him at safety. What we watched is the quarterback.
